prompt: Sarah, a new system administrator, has been handed a task to add a new LDAP entry for a user named "John Doe". She has a file named johndoe.ldif that contains the necessary LDAP data. Which of the following commands should Sarah use to correctly add this user to the LDAP directory?
explanation: The ldapadd command is used to add entries to the LDAP directory. The -f option specifies the LDIF file that contains the LDAP entries to be added. The -W option prompts for the LDAP directory password, ensuring security.
